verdict.rationale: GitBook has no documented sandbox or test environment. Its closest equivalent is content isolation: agents can open change requests (branch-like drafts) through the MCP server instead of editing published docs, and preview deployments let changes be reviewed before going live. That is a staging workflow for content, not a separate sandbox org or test API environment. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test workspace or API environment, explicit documentation of isolating agent actions from production data, and hands-on corroboration.
